answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a Sybil-resistant mechanism known as Proof of Physical Location (PPL). Each agent is required to prove its physical presence at a unique location, such as a knoll on a remote island, by providing cryptographically secure evidence of owning a specific plot of timber or other unique physical asset. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would need to acquire and control multiple plots, significantly increasing the cost and complexity of the attack, thereby securing the network.
